Owing to the Surrey Relays on the same day we were short of sprinters for this meeting. Our 4 x 110 team consisted of Underwood, Holtum, Bartlett and Mullen, while our 4 x 440 team was Kennedy, Alan Bishop, Ken.

This was held on the same evening as the Tadworth match and our numbers suffered accordingly, but we did not do so badly, and in a five-sided contest we finished in third position. Gordon Lowers won the 100 yards and Mullen won the 220, while Stan Davies was third in the Mile and Bergvalds was second in the Shot Putt.
The senior match saw " Ginger " Holtum win the 100, with " Paddy " Mullen second in the 220, while Jim Heathfield was third in the 440 yards.
